verdict.rationale:
Cognee's ingestion pipeline automatically extracts entities and builds a knowledge graph rather than storing raw text verbatim (docs-16), and `.improve()` is explicitly designed to consolidate short-term session memory into permanent memory in the background of a session (docs-31, docs-19). However, both `.remember` and `.improve` are explicit, user/agent-invoked API calls rather than an autonomous decision process that judges salience on its own — there's no evidence of the system independently deciding what to discard vs. keep beyond structured extraction.

missing for 10: evidence of autonomous/automatic triggering of consolidation without explicit calls, evidence of selective filtering of non-salient content vs. full extraction of everything ingested.
